approved: Tax Laws Amendment (2013 Measures No. 3) Bill 2013
Moved that the Tax Laws Amendment (2013 Measures No. 3) Bill 2013 be referred to the Federation Chamber for further consideration, with debate adjourned to a later hour that day.

Supported a revised tax laws bill after consultation addressed coalition concerns about financial advice regulation, including transitional arrangements, exemptions and clearer definitions, and supported adding the Australian Council of Social Service Inc. and Make a Mark Australia to deductible gift recipient provisions.
